idea-plugin.name: Maekom API Runner
idea-plugin.description:
Maekom API Runner — Open-source (Apache License 2.0) Spring Boot API Scenario Runner & PSI Auto-Sampler for IntelliJ IDEA.
  • 🌶️ Gutter chili icon on Spring Web controller endpoints (@GetMapping, @PostMapping, @PutMapping, @DeleteMapping, @PatchMapping, @RequestMapping)
  • Auto-extracts @RequestParam, @ModelAttribute & POJO/record fields into a dedicated Params tab with Javadoc/@Schema/@Parameter descriptions, and generates JSON samples from @RequestBody DTOs & records
  • Consolidated Scenario Management (New, Rename, Duplicate, Delete), Import Common Headers (Merge/Overwrite preview from other scenarios), 30-second debounced Smart Auto-Save, and dirty-check confirmation
  • Unified 3-tab Variables Hub ({{$}}) with persistent project-wide Global Variables (.maekom/global-variables.json with Secret masking), 8 built-in live dynamic variables, right-click insertion, and automatic Variable Name Duplicate Validation with smart recommendations
  • Multi-step scenario chaining with Jayway JsonPath extraction, built-in Extract Guide, one-click Response JSON field extraction, Fail-Fast policy, Copy as cURL (single step & full scenario), responsive toolbars, KO / EN switch, and instant Plugin Update Checker & Notifications

License: Apache License, Version 2.0 (Open Source — maekom-hub/maekom-api-runner)
